author: ctfdn_official
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content:
HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES

Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027.

If you have a talent for bringing nightmares to life—from unsettling atmosphere to terrifying creatures—we’d love to see your work.

Experience with illustrated lettering or incorporating text into your artwork is a plus, but not required.

These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only for this particular endeavor. We won’t accept AI-generated or AI-assisted artwork.

Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability:

Email: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com
Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: dzinrz
title: We're Hiring Illustrators
content:
WE’RE HIRING ILLUSTRATORS!

Are you a skilled illustrator with a passion for creativity and storytelling? We’d love to see your work!

At The Dzinrz Illustration Studio, we bring stories to life through children’s book illustrations, character design, and a variety of creative projects.

Who can apply?
Anyone with strong illustration skills, creativity, and a passion for creating engaging artwork is welcome to apply. We value talent, creativity, and the willingness to grow!

📍 Location: Applicants from Gujrat, Pakistan, will be given priority. Remote work opportunities are also available for talented artists from other locations.

📩 How to apply:
Send your portfolio or work samples to hello@thedzinrz.com

🌐 Visit www.thedzinrz.com to explore our portfolio and get a better understanding of the projects we work on.
